title: UFO Investigation Memoir Adapted for TV by Terence Winter
description: Terence Winter is developing a TV adaptation of Jay Stratton's memoir about U.S. government UFO investigations, set for publication on October 13 by William Morrow.

title: The Sopranos Writer Making TV Show About US Government’s Real-Life UFO Cover-Ups
description: The Sopranos writer is diving into UFO territory next. He’s developing a TV adaptation of a memoir about alleged U.S. government UFO investigations.
